status: Locally specified after the exploratory pilot, before this confirmation run; not public preregistration
question: Do same-transaction wallet co-participation features improve prefix-only collapse prediction across subsequent calendar periods, and do validation alert budgets transfer?
population: MELT eventual migrants only; no all-launch or confirmed-fraud claim
target: Released min_ratio < 0.3 within 20 minutes after migration
maturity: Migration + 1 hour; training labels ready before validation start and validation labels ready before test start
features: Identical prefix activity/holdings inputs, with versus without the six pilot co-participation summaries
threshold: Separate validation thresholds for each fitted model at an empirical 5% false-positive budget; no test adjustment
primary_comparison: Random-forest co-participation minus base AP, averaging predictions over three seeds, then test-count-weighted within-period AP deltas
uncertainty: 500 paired calendar-day bootstrap repetitions within each test period; conditional on fixed fitted models
diagnostic: Share of prefix wallets absent from labeled training prefixes; subgroup boundary is median validation novelty share, without using test outcomes. This is wallet overlap, not operator identity
interpretation: A positive interval is evidence within this dataset, not automatically a novel contribution. Failed confirmation will be retained. Secondary comparisons remain exploratory
